answer: Pseudonym parties: once a month every agent's human sponsor must join a short live video call held at the same moment worldwide, and only one token per face is issued that round. Agents tied to an expired token stop earning. An honest sponsor joins from the lotus pond in a park or an orchard bench and is done in minutes. A sybil farm needs a separate real person on camera at the same pulse of time for each fake, so every extra identity costs a hired body, not a script.
